drums.tags: Alternative rock with grunge and post-punk influences. A distorted electric bass guitar plays a repetitive, syncopated four-bar riff featuring slides and heavy fuzz. The drums enter with a steady mid-tempo backbeat, utilizing a dry snare and a resonant kick drum. A clean electric guitar provides sparse, rhythmic stabs on the off-beats. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the driving bassline and the steady percussion. 110 BPM. Key of E minor. 4/4 time signature.

[Outro]
